BRELA COSOTA split: Intellectual property in Tanzania is split between two bodies. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) administers: trademarks (alama za biashara), patents (hati miliki), and industrial designs (miundo ya viwanda). COSOTA (Copyright Society of Tanzania) administers: copyright and neighbouring rights (haki za ubunifu na haki jirani). There is NO body called ORT — ort.go.tz does not exist as a Tanzanian IP registry.

presumptive tax bands 2022: Kodi ya makadirio (presumptive income tax) kwa mtu binafsi, kwa MAUZO ya mwaka: hadi TZS 4,000,000 = TZS 0; zaidi ya 4,000,000 hadi 7,000,000 = TZS 100,000 (asiyetunza kumbukumbu) au 3% ya mauzo yanayozidi 4,000,000 (anayetunza); zaidi ya 7,000,000 hadi 11,000,000 = TZS 250,000 (asiyetunza) au TZS 90,000 pamoja na 3% ya yanayozidi 7,000,000 (anayetunza); kuanzia 11,000,001 hadi 200,000,000 = 4.0% ya mauzo yote (ilikuwa asilimia 3.5, ilipanda WEF 1 Julai 2026). Pia: mfanyabiashara mpya mwenye TIN aliyoipata kwa ajili ya kuanzisha biashara hii ndani ya miezi 12 anaweza kustahili msamaha wa TZS 0 (hadi TZS 200,000,000 za mauzo) -- LAKINI si wa moja kwa moja, lazima aombe kwa Kamishna na aidhinishwe (First Schedule para 2(4), mpya).
